source.description: Reviewed handmade raster pencil-process contact sheet, cropped only after the full six-panel sequence was approved.
source.notes: One right-facing harvest mouse holds one curved wheat stalk; no lettering, arrows, UI, signatures, or watermarks.

process_strategy: Six cumulative panels move from a sparse mouse pose and wheat route to silhouette, ears and paws, wheat head and face, graphite value with restrained color, then a finishing-only pass.

final_elements.name: harvest mouse pose
final_elements.description: One small right-facing mouse with a round head, pear-shaped body, two feet, and a curved tail.

final_elements.name: wheat stalk route
final_elements.description: One gently curved wheat stalk held diagonally between the mouse paws.

final_elements.name: mouse silhouette and tail
final_elements.description: A single connected mouse silhouette with a long thin tail that curls behind the body.

final_elements.name: ears paws and face
final_elements.description: Exactly two rounded ears, two holding paws, one bright eye, one tiny nose, and short whiskers.

final_elements.name: wheat head and ground shadow
final_elements.description: One narrow wheat head with paired grains plus one short broken ground shadow beneath the feet.

final_elements.name: graphite texture and restrained color
final_elements.description: Soft graphite fur hatching, warm brown mouse tint, ochre wheat tint, and cool-gray shadow applied to established forms.

overlap_reservations.background_lines_stop_before: The wheat gesture stops at the two pale paw placement ovals instead of crossing through the future hands.
The tail and body contour leave the diagonal stalk route clear so it reads as one held foreground stem.

frames.step_name: Map the mouse and wheat route
frames.visible_job: Place a pale head circle, pear-shaped body envelope, two foot ovals, two paw ovals, one curved tail gesture, one diagonal wheat route, and a short shadow footprint.
Connect only the right-facing head and body into one soft mouse silhouette, then draw the long thin tail while preserving the paw, wheat, face, and shadow guides.
Draw exactly two rounded ears, two paws around the established stalk route, one eye, one tiny nose, and short whiskers.
Turn the established upper stalk route into one narrow wheat head with paired grains and add the existing short broken ground shadow.
Add soft graphite fur hatching, warm brown mouse tint, ochre wheat tint, and cool-gray shadow only to the established mouse, stalk, wheat head, and ground.

final_step.visible_job: Only clarify established keeper contours, graphite texture, restrained color, and the short shadow.

rejection_checks: Reject any panel where the mouse pose, two ears, two paws, one stalk, or wheat-head placement drifts.
Reject a final that introduces the tail, paws, face, wheat grains, or color absent in an earlier panel.
Reject clean vector-like lines, polished animal art, a detailed first panel, or a non-cumulative redraw.
